task.title: Managing Users
task.shortdesc: As an administrator, you can create, suspend, and remove user accounts in through the administration portal.

context.p: User management is performed through the web-based administration portal at . You must be logged in with an account that has the Organization Administrator role to access these features.

step.cmd: Log in to the administration portal at .
Enter the new user's Full Name, Email Address, and assign a temporary Password.
Select the appropriate Role: User or Administrator.
Notify the new user of their credentials and instruct them to change their password on first login.

result.p: The new account is active immediately. The user can log in to using the provided credentials.

task.title: Suspending a User Account
task.shortdesc: Suspending an account prevents the user from logging in without permanently deleting their message history.

step.cmd: In the administration portal, go to Users All Users and locate the account.
Click the user's name to open their profile.
Click Suspend Account and confirm the action.

result.p: The user is immediately signed out of all active sessions and cannot log in until the account is reactivated.

task.title: Deleting a User Account
task.shortdesc: Permanently removes a user account and all associated data from the organization.

prereq.note: This action is irreversible. All messages, profile data, and settings associated with the account will be permanently deleted.

step.cmd: In the administration portal, go to Users All Users and locate the account.
Click the user's name to open their profile.
Click Delete Account, type the user's email address to confirm, then click Permanently Delete.
